images.prompt: Scene: a tidy desk seen from a slight high angle. On the laptop screen, an abstract video editor: a row of small thumbnail frames, a waveform strip and a timeline bar, all as simple shapes. Beside the laptop: a small exhibition booth display stand miniature showing a looping video (abstract green-and-white image), a pair of headphones, a paper storyboard sheet with six small sketched rectangles (no writing), and a cup of coffee. A person's hands (no face) type on the keyboard. Composition: laptop at center-left, booth miniature at right, generous empty space at the top.
